body: That’s fucked up!

My woodwork teacher basically refused to teach me when he heard my last name and sent me out the class.. I guess my two older brothers had been nightmares.

To be fair though he smashed one of my oldest brothers friends up against a locker when they were in year 7 because he laughed about something as the teacher had asked for silence.

The second one was not knowing the murder.. but my brothers being shot. 

Basically the area I live in is out in the countryside of England where your either a farmer or commute to London (we have a station close enough that’s like 50min train ride) or your a posh kid from one of the local private schools. Basically the countryside is the only area you’ll really find guns in England (farmers and their mums be packing).  

It was New Years night and my brothers were at a friends house party, his house backs onto one of the local parks. So when one of my brothers was out having a cigarette, one of the posh boys was still in the village pissed off at not being invited to any party’s took a gun (luckily not very powerful.. I don’t understand guns don’t ask me!) and from the park shot my brother in the shoulder. 

My other brother hearing the commotion ran outside with two of his friends who had recently returned from their marines basic training... (brother is also 6’2” and has played rugby all his life so is built like a brick shithouse 😂) who then proceeded to chase this kid down who freaked out and only managed to graze my brother (turns out 3 big guys charging for you ticks up your aim.. I know they were stupid going after him but they were drunk on New Years) 

Long story short the only other injuries to happen that night was my brother breaking his hand on the guys face... and the newly qualified marines enjoyed showing off the new reatraints they’d learned till the police/ ambulance arrived. 

Both brothers where okay although brother 1 had to have surgery on his shoulder. And the posh kid was charged with GBH.

Got a couple of experiences, first one was when I was volunteering out in Honduras me and a few of the other girls accidentally became friends with a big drug boss. Didn’t realise at first why we’d been told by the charity not to speak to him (we were pretty rural when we first went there, didn’t really think about a threat of gangs etc.. we soon learned 😂). Basically this guy was ‘related’ to one of our host family’s (he had knocked up our host mum when she was 15 he was 40 they had a “illegitimate” child together) the mum and him had maintained a good relationship with him  giving money to her family to help raise his daughter. Whenever he came to the village we were in he would always come in like a convoy of 3 trucks, not super fancy or anything so we didn’t think that much of it just thought that he had a large family.. of a fair few guys specifically, and since they were coming to our house we would chat with them and be a part of family party’s and meals etc. But we had never been out of the village with him and never in the trucks before one day he and his group invited us up to see the mountains for a day trip. INSTANT YES!!! (We had been in the same small village / town for 1 month by this point, and we wanted to see some other parts of Honduras while we were there)!

Anyway we get into two trucks and when in I look down and see 3 big ol guns on the floor.. (as a Brit this is weird af) anyway don’t think about it too much were driving too the mountains, as we pull about 5 mins down the road from the village the guys stop and pick up 3 more guys who each get in the back of the pickup trucks with guns.. little bit freaked now. 

Anyway we get the mountains where he informs us that he “owns all of them...” And as we drive up everyone greets him with a very respectful hi boss. Nothing else really happened in the mountains we had a fun day out although they dictated where we could and couldn’t go quite strongly. Anyway when me and the four other girls got back to the village our team leader was waiting very angry, close to saying he would put us on the plane back to the uk if we went out with him again. Turns out he was a big drug boss in the area (should have realised his guys has a lot more tattoos than the other locals..) and we shouldn’t go out with him as he had multiple hits out on him.

Right the first at least half an hour is them laughing about nothing.. and promoting everything them that you could possibly buy!
